context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 70 verified 4 new features: (1) Teacher role has 'Booster Students' link in sidebar under TEACHING section, navigates to /teacher/booster page with summary cards and empty state. (2) Parent and Student roles do NOT see Knowledge Base in sidebar - it's only shown to staff roles. (3) Parent and Student roles do NOT see emergency alert popups (AnnouncementPopup, EmergencyAlertPopup hidden via isStaffRole check in DashboardLayout). (4) Scheme of Work create/upload is restricted to MGMT_ROLES only - plain Teacher gets 403 on POST /api/schemes/, but HeadOfAcademics (which IS a management role) can create schemes. Push notification bell sound is implemented via Web Audio API in notifications.js, triggered by WebSocket 'new_notification' event in TermContext.js, and service worker sends PLAY_NOTIFICATION_SOUND message on push events.
